title: Tooth device demonstration at the Pentagon
summary: Andrija Puharich tells of Tooth device demonstration at the Pentagon, about 1960s at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We gave a demonstration at the Pentagon. We fitted this device to this general,

plain: Andrija Puharich, a researcher described in a podcast episode title as a CIA scientist, says in recorded remarks that in the 1960s he and others gave a demonstration at the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US military. According to him, they fitted a small device, worn at the tooth, to a general to show what it could do. He tells it as a sign that the military took his unusual inventions seriously.
